projectSummary: The clearest retrieved statement that bench inclination reverses which pectoralis head is more excited. The acute cross-sectional area change is a tier-5 swelling measure and is not evidence of growth.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Acute post-exercise cross-sectional area is explicitly a tier-5 context outcome under master plan section 2.2 and must never be read as hypertrophy.

study.intervention: flat bench press; 45-degree inclined bench press
study.population: Thirteen men performed four sets of the flat and of the 45-degree inclined bench press. Bipolar surface EMGs were acquired from both pectoralis major heads, and panoramic ultrasound images were collected transversely to the fibres before and immediately after exercise; normalised root-mean-square amplitude and variations in cross-sectional area and muscle thickness were calculated separately for each head.

title: Non-uniform excitation of pectoralis major induced by changes in bench press inclination leads to uneven variations in the cross-sectional area measured by panoramic ultrasonography.
